decisions.reason: The indoor air quality sensor still fits the platform and customer base well, but sensor-specific hardware is somewhat more exposed to component changes and portfolio pruning than core interface modules.
The voltage measurement module remains a core building block for prototyping and automation, so it is likely to stay unless a newer hardware revision replaces this specific generation.
The MQTT proxy strengthens software connectivity for the modular system at relatively low maintenance cost, making withdrawal less likely than for niche hardware accessories.
The CO2 sensor module serves clear educational, lab and building-monitoring use cases and should remain attractive, though sensor hardware can still face replacement or supply-driven retirement.
